# Rakesh Krishnan

> Senior DevSecOps & Release Engineer and AI Platform Engineer with 20 years in enterprise software (energy utilities and banking). Builds enterprise CI/CD platforms on GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, AWS and Azure; leads enterprise AI coding-assistant adoption (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code); modernizes legacy mainframe systems. Based in San Diego, CA; open to relocation.

Highlights:
- Led the enterprise-wide rollout of AI coding assistants to 200+ developers, with a 50% productivity gain, usage policies, LLM model selection and spend governance.
- Consolidating an 800+ repository estate across 4 orgs onto GitHub Enterprise; standardizing reusable CI/CD templates across 1,200+ repositories.
- Built a self-service DevOps provisioning portal (React, .NET, Azure SQL) that cut developer onboarding overhead by 40%.
- Manages monthly production releases of 10-15 projects, with ServiceNow change automation and CAB facilitation.
- Earlier at Bank of America (via Infosys): replaced COBOL batch loads with a mainframe ETL that saved $300K-$400K per application per year.

Core skills: GitHub Enterprise (EMU), GitHub Actions, GitHub Advanced Security, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, MCP, Azure DevOps, AWS, Azure, Terraform, Docker, CheckMarx (SAST), ServiceNow, Python, C#, .NET, React, JavaScript, PowerShell, Bash, SQL, Power BI, DB2, COBOL.
